title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-14
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording that captures a strong show highlighted by an epic Not Fade Away and superb acoustic Katie Mae
ai_review.review: The archive entry provides a crystal‑clear soundboard mix with the band well balanced—Phil’s bass is pushed forward, the drums sit deep but are a bit long‑winded, and the overall fidelity is praised as exceptional. Musically the performance shines on Not Fade Away, the ABYGN jam, Dark Star, Katie Mae acoustic solo and a standout Hard To Handle where Phil’s playing is lauded. While some fans lament missing portions of the full concert, the material that is present is consistently rated highly.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 5‑star ratings and praise both the audio fidelity and musical moments; only a few low stars concern missing tracks, not recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is front‑heavy on Phil, balanced overall, crisp clarity; no reported dropouts or muffiness. The drum segment is long but the soundstage remains clean.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows through a lengthy drum break (≈12 min) into cosmic jams; overall energy is high and the show is considered slightly less dazzling than 2/13 but still great.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is prominently mixed and praised as next‑level, especially on 'Hard To Handle'.
band_member_comments.Drums: A 12‑minute drum segment is noted as long‑winded yet integral to the jam flow.
